purpose: Teach: 仰せ/平家/国際線/保養/切り離さ/造語/部外/三越

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、上司の仰せに従われますね
lines.en: The police follow their superiors' orders, don't they?
lines.style: Measured, conversational cadence. Light affirmation-seeking lift at the end. Steady, respectful tone—not challenging, just confirming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、平家ゆかりの史跡警備もされますね
lines.en: The police also guard historical sites connected to the Heike clan, don't they?
lines.style: Same measured rhythm as before. Slight emphasis on 'also'—building a list. Respectful curiosity, no edge.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、国際線到着時の入管連携もされますね
lines.en: The police coordinate with immigration at international arrivals too, I understand?
lines.style: Continuing the steady enumeration. Tone remains warm and acknowledging. Light questioning rise, genuine rather than challenging.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、保養施設での盗難事案も対応されますね
lines.en: The police also handle theft cases at resort facilities, yes?
lines.style: Fourth item in the list. Pace unchanged, tone consistent. The rhythm of someone moving through a series of confirmations without urgency.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、本件を別の事件と切り離さない捜査もされますね
lines.en: The police investigate this case without separating it from other incidents, correct?
lines.style: Still measured, but with a touch more intention on 'without separating'—this one matters slightly. Warm, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、隠語、造語の解読技術もお持ちですね
lines.en: The police have skill in decoding slang and neologisms too, I see?
lines.style: Light, almost appreciative tone here. Rhythm steady but with a hint of genuine admiration for the technical skill. Questioning but warm.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、部外秘の捜査情報を厳格に管理されますね
lines.en: The police strictly manage confidential investigative information, of course?
lines.style: Slightly more formal on this one. Respectful affirmation. The pace tightens just barely—this is a serious point. Still collaborative in tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、三越前の万引き多発も対応されますね
lines.en: The police also handle the frequent shoplifting incidents near Mitsukoshi, right?
lines.style: Shift here—slightly closer, more direct. The tone becomes more pointed, less purely confirmatory. Still respectful but with an edge of genuine inquiry beneath.
